messages:
Ravi: Quick microcopy question for the global shortcut tooltip on the Console search. Currently tooltip reads: 'Press / to search'. Feels terse and ambiguous for screen reader users.

Kim: I saw that. Two issues: 1) 'search' might be unclear (search what?), 2) the tooltip disappears quickly on hover, so keyboard users may miss it.

Dana: Proposed longer tooltip: 'Press / to focus global search (models, deployments, docs)'. Gives context. But it's longer and may be clipped in the UI.

Ravi: I like the added context. Alternative: keep the short tooltip but add an accessible aria-label with the longer text for screen readers. For visual users, short copy is fine.

AccessibilityBot: Recommended pattern: visible tooltip short + aria-describedby with full explanation. Example strings: visible: 'Press / to search' aria text: 'Press slash to focus global search. Search across models, deployments, and docs.' Also ensure the shortcut is announced via Live Region when pressed and focus lands in the input.

Kim: UX nit: use words users expect. We call the top bar 'Global search' in docs, so match that: visible 'Press / for global search' aria: 'Press slash to focus global search. Use it to find models, deployments, and docs.'

Dana: Localization note: avoid punctuation-heavy sentences and parentheticals. Short sentence fragments translate better. Maybe aria: 'Press / to focus the global search. Search models, deployments, and docs.'

Product: Tagging for voice: prefer 'global search' as canonical. Also confirm we want to include 'docs' in the list vs 'resources'.

Ravi: Final proposed strings for engineers: visibleTooltip: "Press / for global search" ariaDescription: "Press slash to focus the global search. Search models, deployments, and docs." liveRegionMessage: "Global search focused" buttonTooltip: "Open global search (/)"

Kim: Tiny UI ask: make tooltip max-width 320px so the longer aria text isn't visually cramped if used in future. Also ensure we show a small cheat sheet modal on first login that lists shortcuts with full descriptions.

AccessibilityBot: Also add keyboard guidance in the component spec: ensure the tooltip and aria-describedby IDs are unique per page instance and that focusable elements have visible focus ring.

Dana: I'll update the Figma copy and the component spec with these strings and ARIA notes, then open a PR to the design system. Tagging @Product for copy approval and localization.

Product: Approved on voice. Thanks all :thumbsup:
